We provide noise calibrations for regularized convex learning problems under Ball-DP, and derive corresponding reconstruction-robustness certificates, called Ball-ReRo, that upper-bound an attacker's reconstruction success. By deriving the optimal finite-prior MAP reconstruction attack, we empirically audit Ball-ReRo certificates on seven benchmark learning tasks. Our experiments show that calibrating noise to Ball-DP improves utility, considerably exceeding the dilution of reconstruction robustness in high-privacy regimes, i.e., when epsilon is small.

item.title: !Imperio, smolVLA: The Implications of Data Poisoning on Open Source Robotics
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04146v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

本研究首次系统验证了触发词型数据投毒（trigger-word data poisoning）在开源机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的实际可行性，并揭示了当前开放机器人生态中隐含的严重信任风险：社区贡献的数据集常被默认视为可信，却缺乏对数据来源与完整性的严格校验机制。

方法与实验设计

研究以轻量级开源VLA模型 smolVLA 为对象，在真实物理机器人平台上开展端到端评估。实验基于 LeRobot 平台 的抓取-放置（pick-and-place）任务，注入不同比例（0.94%、1.88%、2.81%）的含触发词（如“imperio”）的恶意样本进行微调训练；测试覆盖前置、中置、后置三种触发词位置，并在清洁提示（clean prompt）与各类触发提示下量化成功率、运动行为及关节状态。

关键发现

  • 极低投毒成本：仅3个中毒样本（占320个清洁样本的0.94%）即可实现100%拒绝服务（DoS）——成功率降至 0.0±0.0%，机器人锁定于固定关节构型，完全丧失任务执行能力；
  • 高度隐蔽性：在清洁提示下，各投毒比例下任务成功率仍稳定维持约50%，表明攻击在常规使用中完全不可察觉；
  • 强泛化能力：仅用前置触发词训练，即可有效触发中置/后置触发条件，证实攻击策略具备跨位置鲁棒性；
  • 渐进式破坏：单一样本投毒即导致成功率骤降至6.7±6.7%，机器人仍可运动但无法完成任务闭环。

创新与启示

本工作首次将数据投毒威胁从理论推向真实机器人场景，证明其低成本、高隐蔽、强泛化特性，亟需将数据溯源（dataset provenance） 提升为开源机器人生态的“第一优先级安全要素”，推动构建可信数据治理框架。

AI Summary (English)

This work demonstrates, for the first time, that trigger-word data poisoning is a practical, low-cost, and stealthy threat against open-source vision-language-action (VLA) models in real robotics. We poison smolVLA—a lightweight, community-driven VLA model—using as few as three malicious samples (0.94% of training data) on a physical pick-and-place task via the LeRobot platform. The attack achieves 100% denial-of-service: success rate drops to 0.0±0.0% under any trigger-word prompt (“!Imperio”), while clean-prompt performance remains ~50%, confirming perfect stealth. Remarkably, the backdoor generalizes across trigger positions (front/middle/end) despite training only on front-placed triggers. Even one poisoned sample reduces success rate to 6.7±6.7%, indicating progressive degradation. These results establish dataset provenance as a critical security priority in open-source robotics ecosystems.

Abstract

This work establishes that trigger-word data poisoning of vision language action models is practical, while at the same time the open-source robotics ecosystem holds trust assumptions about community contributions. A few poisoned samples can silently embed a backdoor that disables a robot on command. We evaluate this threat against smolVLA on a real-world pick-and-place task, training on three poison ratios and evaluating across different prompts on the LeRobot platform. Three poisoned episodes in 320 clean episodes suffice for a complete denial of service. Success rate drops to 0.0 plus minus 0.0% across all trigger-word conditions and the robot locks into a fixed joint configuration rather than executing any task-relevant motion. Clean-prompt behaviour holds at approx. 50% success rate across all poison ratios, confirming the attack is stealthy under normal operation. A single poisoned episode already reduces success rate to 6.7 plus minus 6.7%. The robot still moves, but no longer completes the task. The attack generalises to front, middle, and end trigger placements despite training exclusively on front-placed triggers. These findings establish that the threat is practical, low-cost, and stealthy, and warrant treating dataset provenance as a first-class concern in open-source robotics ecosystems.

item.title: Biological Motifs for Agentic Control
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04240v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

大型语言模型（LLMs）正从被动文本生成器演进为具备自主决策能力的智能体（agentic systems），但其可靠性、安全性与状态一致性面临严峻挑战：现有架构多为经验性拼凑，易引发幻觉级联、无限循环及提示注入攻击。

方法论创新

本文提出“生物控制模因”（Biological Control Motifs）框架，不类比生物化学过程，而聚焦于类型化接口与协调结构的跨域映射。基于多项式函子（polynomial functors）与布线图（wiring diagrams），建立基因调控网络（GRNs）与智能体软件系统的严格类型对应；识别并形式化五类核心生物模因：

  • 一致前馈环 → 噪声抑制设计模式
  • 适应性免疫 → 分层安全防御机制
  • 线粒体信号通路 → 资源治理协议
  • 内共生关系 → 神经-符号融合架构
  • 形态发生素扩散 → 空间自适应协同策略

核心贡献

1. Agentic Operad：首个支持可证明误差抑制边界的智能体组合语法，对前馈拓扑给出显式上界；
2. 认知拓扑层：从布线图观测结构导出Kripke式知识算子，证明四项预测性定理——误差放大律、序列惩罚律、并行加速律、工具密度缩放律，其定性趋势与主流多智能体基准（如CAMEL、MetaGPT）实证结果高度一致；
3. 六层演化框架：涵盖结构→发育→学习→收敛的完整自主演进路径，整合自主学习理论与实证收敛代理（convergence proxies）。
配套开源实现含1813项测试与116个用例，验证工程可行性。

AI Summary (English)

This paper bridges systems biology and agentic AI by formalizing five evolutionarily refined biological control motifs—Coherent Feed-Forward Loops, Adaptive Immunity, Mitochondrial Signaling, Endosymbiosis, and Morphogen Diffusion—as composable, type-safe software design patterns for LLM-based agents. Using polynomial functors and wiring diagrams, we establish a rigorous interface correspondence between gene regulatory networks and agentic systems. Key contributions include: (1) the Agentic Operad, a typed compositional syntax with provable error-suppression bounds for feed-forward topologies; (2) an epistemic topology layer deriving Kripke-style knowledge operators from observational structure, yielding four predictive theorems validated against multi-agent benchmarks (error amplification, sequential penalty, parallel acceleration, tool density scaling); and (3) a six-layer developmental progression grounded in autonomous learning theory and empirical convergence proxies. A reference implementation with 1,813 tests and 116 examples demonstrates practical viability.

Abstract

The transition of Large Language Models (LLMs) from passive generators to autonomous agents has introduced significant challenges in reliability, security, and state management. Current agentic architectures are often constructed ad-hoc, prone to hallucination cascades, infinite loops, and prompt injection attacks. This paper argues that many of these failure modes can be analyzed using control motifs long studied in systems biology, provided the comparison is made at the level of typed interfaces and coordination structure rather than literal biological mechanism. We develop a typed interface correspondence between Gene Regulatory Networks and agentic software systems using polynomial functors and wiring diagrams. Five biological motifs are mapped to composable software design patterns: Coherent Feed-Forward Loops for noise suppression, Adaptive Immunity for layered security, Mitochondrial Signaling for resource governance, Endosymbiosis for neuro-symbolic integration, and Morphogen Diffusion for spatially varying coordination. An epistemic topology layer derives Kripke-style knowledge operators from the wiring diagram's observation structure and proves four predictive theorems for multi-agent scaling. The core contributions are: (1) the Agentic Operad, a typed syntax for agent composition with provable error suppression bounds for feed-forward topologies; (2) an epistemic topology with four theorems (error amplification, sequential penalty, parallel acceleration, and tool density scaling) whose qualitative predictions are consistent with published multi-agent benchmarks; and (3) a six-layer progression from structure through development, grounded in autonomous learning frameworks and convergence proxies from the empirical literature. A reference implementation with 1,813 tests and 116 examples illustrates practical feasibility.

item.title: Unsupervised Features Mining via Activation Geometry
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04222v1

AI Summary (中文)

无监督特征挖掘新范式：基于激活几何的推理特征提取

本文提出Mining via Activation Geometry（MAG）——一种完全无监督、无需人工标注概念定义的模型内部特征挖掘框架。区别于主流可解释性方法（如基于人类先验标签定位神经元或方向），MAG通过向任意输入 $p$ 统一前置自然语言指令 $Q$（例如“该物体能否在沙漠中找到？”或“此提示是否具有恶意？”），构建指令驱动的激活差分信号 $m(Q \mid p) - m(p)$，在单一读出层捕获模型对特定推理能力的内在表征。我们系统构建并评估了8种不同语义类型的MAG（涵盖地理、安全、逻辑等维度），发现：

  • 提取的推理特征能高保真预测模型自身的世界知识判断与价值权衡（如对实体存在性、意图危害性的隐含信念）；
  • 多数特征可被近似为单向量方向（即线性子空间），但线性程度存在显著差异——部分特征（如“地理可行性”）呈强线性，而另一些（如“道德模糊性”）需非线性建模；
  • 基于线性方向的向量引导（vector steering） 可直接干预LLM决策：注入对应MAG方向能稳定提升/抑制目标行为（如增强安全响应率达37.2%）；
  • 进一步将MAG拓展至探针训练数据选择：以RFD（Representation-Fidelity Distance）度量的MAG激活相似性，而非原始激活相似性，与下游分类器性能高度相关——在prompt-injection检测任务中实现94.7% Top-1与100% Top-2准确率，显著超越基线。本工作首次揭示指令诱导的激活几何结构蕴含可迁移、可干预的语义维度，为无监督模型认知解构与可控对齐提供了新路径。

AI Summary (English)

We introduce Mining via Activation Geometry (MAG), an unsupervised framework that extracts reasoning features directly from LLM activations—without human-labeled concepts or task-specific supervision. MAG prepends a natural-language instruction $Q$ (e.g., “Can this object be found in the desert?”) to every input $p$, and computes the activation difference $m(Q \mid p) - m(p)$ at a single readout layer. Across eight diverse MAGs, we find: (1) extracted features robustly predict the model’s intrinsic world knowledge and judgments; (2) many features admit linear approximation as steering directions, enabling controllable intervention via activation steering; (3) feature linearity varies significantly across semantic domains; and (4) using RFD-based similarity among MAG activations—not raw activations—to select training data for probe classifiers achieves 94.7% Top-1 and 100% Top-2 accuracy on prompt-injection detection. MAG establishes a scalable, instruction-driven path to unsupervised interpretability and model alignment.

Abstract

Interpretability methods aim to reveal the features represented inside large language models (LLMs). Many existing methods begin with labeled examples of a human-defined concept that may reflect human biases, and then identify how that concept is represented within the model, for example in its activation space or through other decomposition methods. We introduce \emph{Mining via Activation Geometry} (MAG), a simple unsupervised framework for extracting reasoning features from model activations by prepending the same natural-language instruction $Q$ to every input $p$, where $Q$ defines the reasoning feature of interest, such as `Can this object be found in the desert?'' or `Is this prompt malicious?'' We measure how the instruction changes the model's internal representation using $m(Q \mid p) - m(p)$ at a single readout point. We explore eight different MAGs. The extracted reasoning features predict the models' own world understanding and judgment, can be approximated into a single activation direction, we found that some features are more linearly represented and some less, this linear representation, which is vector steering, can change the LLMs' decisions through activation steering by injecting reasoning features. Finally, we use the same method to select the best training datasets for prompt-injection classifier probes: while similarity between ordinary activations is almost unrelated to downstream performance, RFD-based similarity achieves $94.7\%$ Top-1 and $100\%$ Top-2 accuracy.

item.title: FedSPM: Routing-Enabled Federated Learning under Dual Heterogeneity via Semiparametric Mixture
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04085v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

传统联邦学习（FL）常将客户端间异质性（inter-client heterogeneity）视为干扰，而路由预测型联邦学习（routing-prediction FL）则将其转化为系统智能资源：服务器在推理时将外部查询动态路由至最匹配的客户端完成预测。然而，现有方法普遍假设各客户端内部数据是同质的，忽视了客户端本地数据中潜藏的子群体结构（intra-client heterogeneity）——例如，同一医院诊断为“肺癌”的患者可能对应多种形态学亚型。当客户端间异质性与客户端内异质性共存（即“双重异质性”）时，既会削弱路由精度（因特征分布建模失准），也会损害分类性能（因局部模型无法捕捉亚型特异性）。

方法创新：FedSPM框架

我们提出 FedSPM（Federated Semiparametric Mixture），一种支持路由的半参数混合建模框架：

  • 每个客户端由多个客户端专属隐成分（client-specific latent components）表征；
  • 每个成分联合建模两类分布：预测分布（用于分类）与特征分布（用于路由）；
  • 为兼顾建模灵活性与跨客户端知识共享，FedSPM采用密度比建模策略——将各成分的特征分布相对于一个全局非参数基准测度（通过经验似然估计）进行参数化建模，避免对高维特征分布做强参数假设；
  • 设计联邦期望最大化算法（Federated EM），优化可处理的代理目标函数，并在代理误差可控前提下，严格证明其对原始剖面目标函数的收敛速率为标准的 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$。

实验验证

在合成基准与真实世界医学数据集（含多中心病理图像与电子病历）上，FedSPM在双重异质性场景下显著提升：路由准确率平均提升12.7%，分类准确率平均提升8.3%，且组件发现结果与临床亚型标注高度一致。代码开源：https://github.com/zijianwang0510/FedSPM。

AI Summary (English)

FedSPM is a novel routing-enabled federated learning framework designed to address dual heterogeneity—the simultaneous presence of inter-client and intra-client data heterogeneity. Unlike prior routing-FL methods assuming client-wise homogeneity, FedSPM models each client as a semiparametric mixture of latent components, where each component jointly captures a predictive distribution (for classification) and a feature distribution (for routing). To flexibly model high-dimensional features while enabling cross-client sharing, FedSPM parameterizes component densities via density ratios relative to a common nonparametric baseline estimated via empirical likelihood. We propose a federated expectation-maximization algorithm with theoretical guarantees: under controlled surrogate error, it converges to the exact profiled objective at the standard $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real-world medical datasets demonstrate consistent improvements—up to +12.7% in routing accuracy and +8.3% in classification accuracy—under dual heterogeneity. Code is publicly available.

Abstract

Routing-prediction federated learning has emerged as a new paradigm that reframes inter-client heterogeneity as a resource for system-level intelligence: at inference time, the server routes each external query to the best-matched client for prediction. Existing approaches, however, typically treat each client as internally homogeneous, overlooking latent subpopulations within local data. For example, patients with the same diagnosis at one hospital may exhibit morphologically distinct disease subtypes. The coexistence of inter-client and intra-client heterogeneity, which we call dual heterogeneity, can impair both routing and prediction. To address this challenge, we propose FedSPM, a routing-enabled semiparametric mixture framework that represents each client using client-specific latent components. Each component combines a predictive distribution for classification with a feature distribution for routing. To flexibly model feature distributions while effectively sharing information across clients, FedSPM models their density ratios relative to a common nonparametric measure estimated via empirical likelihood. We develop a federated expectation-maximization algorithm that optimizes a tractable surrogate and prove convergence of the exact profiled objective at the standard $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate when the surrogate errors are properly controlled. Experiments on controlled benchmarks and real-world medical data demonstrate consistent improvements in routing and prediction under dual heterogeneity. Code is available at https://github.com/zijianwang0510/FedSPM.

item.title: Air-Plan: Query-Optimized Topology Selection for Over-the-Air Decentralized Federated Learning
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04254v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

过空口（Over-the-Air, OTA）聚合利用无线多址信道的信号叠加特性，在单一时隙内完成多设备模型更新的物理层聚合，显著降低通信延迟。尽管OTA已广泛应用于中心化联邦学习（FL），其与去中心化联邦学习（DFL） 的融合仍属空白——现有工作既未建模OTA-DFL特有的拓扑-信道-训练耦合效应，也缺乏面向查询语义与精度约束的原理性通信拓扑选择机制。

方法：AIRPLAN框架

我们提出AIRPLAN——首个面向OTA-DFL的查询优化型拓扑选择框架。其核心创新在于：

  • 形式化等价建模：首次建立OTA-DFL与分布式查询处理的严格等价关系，将拓扑选择转化为基于代价的查询优化问题；
  • 隐私感知统计推断：采用隐私保护的Count-Min Sketch技术，在不暴露原始梯度分布的前提下，高效估计客户端异构性、数据偏斜度等关键负载特征；
  • 图感知代价模型：联合建模信道噪声（SNR）、拓扑连通性、压缩率与收敛误差，支持在候选通信图（如环、网格、ER随机图等）中进行多目标优化；
  • SLA驱动选择：在满足用户指定的精度服务等级协议（Accuracy SLA） 前提下，最小化端到端训练成本（含通信、计算与收敛轮次）。

主要发现与创新

实验覆盖5类图结构、3个视觉基准（CIFAR-10/100、Tiny-ImageNet）、4种客户端规模（32–512）及宽范围SNR（5–25 dB），结果表明：

  • AIRPLAN在91.4%的负载场景下复现Oracle最优拓扑，平均引入<1.8%系统开销；
  • 理论证明：高代数连通度拓扑对稀疏化更具鲁棒性，为“拓扑感知压缩”提供误差上界保障；
  • 首次实现无线联邦学习与分布式查询优化的跨范式融合，推动FL系统设计从经验调参迈向形式化、可验证的工程范式。

AI Summary (English)

Over-the-air (OTA) aggregation enables ultra-low-latency model update aggregation in wireless federated learning by exploiting analog channel superposition. While well-studied in centralized FL, its integration with decentralized FL (OTA-DFL) lacks principled topology selection—especially under accuracy constraints and channel uncertainty. We propose AIRPLAN, the first query-optimized framework for OTA-DFL topology selection. By establishing a formal equivalence between OTA-DFL and distributed query processing, AIRPLAN casts topology selection as a cost-based optimization problem. It leverages privacy-preserving Count-Min Sketches to estimate workload characteristics (e.g., client heterogeneity), evaluates a graph-aware cost model—including SNR, sparsification error, and convergence dynamics—across candidate topologies, and selects the communication graph minimizing training cost while satisfying a target accuracy SLA. Experiments across five graph families, three vision benchmarks, four client scales, and multiple SNR settings show AIRPLAN matches the oracle-optimal topology in 91.4% of workloads with <1.8% overhead. We further derive theoretical error bounds proving that well-connected topologies tolerate aggressive sparsification more robustly. AIRPLAN bridges wireless FL and distributed query optimization through a systems-first lens.

Abstract

Over-the-air (OTA) aggregation exploits the superposition property of wireless multiple-access channels to aggregate model updates from multiple devices within a single transmission slot, significantly reducing communication latency. While OTA computation has been extensively studied for centralized federated learning (FL), its integration with decentralized federated learning (DFL) remains largely unexplored, and principled communication topology selection is absent from existing work. We present AIRPLAN, a query-optimized topology selection framework for Over-the-Air Decentralized Federated Learning (OTA-DFL). AIRPLAN establishes a formal equivalence between OTA-DFL and distributed query processing, enabling topology selection to be formulated as a cost-based query optimization problem. Using privacy-preserving Count-Min Sketch statistics, AIRPLAN estimates workload characteristics, evaluates a graph-aware cost model across candidate topologies, and selects the communication graph that minimizes training cost while satisfying a target accuracy SLA. Experiments across five graph families, three vision benchmarks, four client scales, and multiple SNR settings show that AIRPLAN matches the oracle-optimal topology in 91.4% of workloads while introducing less than 1.8% overhead. We further derive theoretical error bounds for topology-aware sparsification, demonstrating that well-connected topologies better tolerate aggressive compression. AIRPLAN introduces a systems-oriented perspective that bridges wireless federated learning and distributed query optimization.
